arlington-heights.intro: 4.8 stars from 700+ Google reviews for our Arlington Heights office.

items.name: Christopher Edberg
items.text: We had a great experience with J Blanton Plumbing, especially Ty Williams. Ty helped us upgrade our ancient, absolutely MASSIVE sump pit setup with a new dual pump system and battery backup. I’m pretty sure our pit qualifies as historical infrastructure at this point, but Ty handled it like a pro.

items.name: Michelle Andrew
items.text: Edgar was as professional and knowledgeable as they come. He took the time to explain what was going on and provide options and he was not pushy in any way. He helped my husband and I make an educated decision and feel good about spending a good chunk of change. Edgar is a fabulous representation of J. Blanton and they are lucky to have him!

items.name: Joel Anderson
items.text: We had a great experience with J. Blanton during a really tough project in an older home.  Thomas Maloney was our plumber for the job and he worked tirelessly all day to complete the job.  Impressive!

elgin.intro: 4.8 stars from 340+ Google reviews for our Elgin office.

items.name: Hershel Perlmutter
items.text: I had a fantastic experience with Edgar as he replaced our kitchen sink drain system. He was thorough and patient with me, as he explained what the issue was and how was going to solve the problem. He even walked me through the repair/installation at key points during the process. I'd highly recommend Edgar and J. Blanton for any of your plumbing needs.

items.name: Dale Lehman
items.text: Jason was assigned the work. He was efficient and skilled when making repairs to a portion of my buildings  cold water supply to the hot water heater. Old corroded galvanized piping was identified as a "loss hazard" by my insurance carrier that needed to be addressed. Typical of older brick buildings access to the piping can be impeded by other piping.  J. Blanton Plumbing scheduled the job for the day after I called.

items.name: Alex Cluster
items.text: The last thing any homeowner wants to see/smell is sewage backing up in their basement but thankfully George came through for us and diagnosed the issue within an hour of us calling for help! He was thorough and professional and we will have a repair completed within 24 hours and for a very reasonable price!

mchenry.intro: 4.7 stars from 600+ Google reviews for our McHenry office.

items.name: Thomas Hund
items.text: I was impressed with Ryan Flynn's work ethics and knowledge concerning our recent water heater installation.  As in everything today, new innovative products are prevalent, which I'm 20 years behind.  Like a teacher, he explained each detail as he removed and assembled the new, highly designed water heater.  Notably for the customer, Ryan is an easy-going and lighthearted kind of guy I enjoyed having in my home.

items.name: Dawn
items.text: Excellent and super friendly. Professional. Last minute call for primary bathroom sink emergency and came out just a few hours after we called. Pictures taken to show my husband all the work done. A job very well done!

items.name: Dave Fairburn
items.text: Team did a great job in installing my sump basin and pump. My basement after 63 years appears to be finally dry. Guys were good in keeping the mess to a minimum. Very customer focused team and company.

algonquin.intro: 4.8 stars from 380+ Google reviews for our Algonquin office.

items.name: Anette de Caussin
items.text: In July, 2025, Aris Sprouts did a thorough inspection of our plumbing/sewer system. He examined every line with his camera and hydro-jetted the lines to remove tree roots and grease. Mr. Sprouts is a very thorough professional and we are very impressed with his work. So far, the hydro-jetting has addressed a sewer fly problem in our home. I highly recommend Aris Sprouts and J. Blanton Plumbing, Sewer & Drain to all home owners in need of plumbing, sewer and drain work.

items.name: Shelley Pederson
items.text: Matt and Peter were extremely professional, knowledgeable and friendly.  Got the job done quickly and walked me thru the new water heater and water softener info after installation. Great experience in an emergency situation! Thank you!

items.name: Jackson Jordan
items.text: Edgar H was great, we had water backup in our basement and he was at our house until 10 at night getting it drained out. He then cleaned out our sewer line and at multiple access points and stopped back out twice after our work was completed to make sure everything looked good. We would definitely recommend Edgar and J Blanton for anyone who needs plumbing work

geneva.intro: 4.9 stars from 350+ Google reviews for our Geneva office.

items.name: Daniel Fronsee
items.text: Hunter Corrigan was our technician. He was here by himself and did a great job putting in a new water heater that needed new piping. Also put a water pan under it to keep out any type basement flooding. When he was on his way here, we added a sump pump and a battery backup pump and he handled it great, very professional. He did a great job!!! I highly recommend J. Blanton and if you happen to get Hunter, you are in great hands.

items.name: Jessica Heffernan
items.text: Michael is knowledgable and did an incredible job.  My house is old, and the amount of work he did with one other technician, was amazing.  All new drains and waste stack in one day.  Fabulous work and happy to spend the money on J Blanton plumbing

items.name: Jeff Barkoff
items.text: Thoughtful evaluation of the work.   Proactive about other areas that need attention without being pushy.  Quality work
